title: Pending-schema list
description: Operations that may lack a full response schema. Shrink only: CI fails if the list has more entries than on the base branch, if an entry does not exist, if an entry already has a closed schema, or (from PR 3) if an integration operation is listed.

operation.description: METHOD and path exactly as in openapi.json (paths are relative to the /api server).

domain.description: Owning domain under apps/api/app/Domain, used to plan follow-up pull requests.

examples.description: Operations whose response bodies are not yet described. Remove a domain's entries in the pull request that describes it.
